# Tachi Club

> Tachi Club makes plug-in digital LCD gauge clusters (instrument cluster swaps) for Toyota GT86 / Subaru BRZ / Scion FR-S, Honda Civic EK and Porsche 987/981 Cayman & Boxster, plus supporting carbon accessories. Made to order, US customers, Los Angeles. Operated by Oli&CeCe Inc. in Commerce (Los Angeles), California. Prices in USD.

## Hero products: digital LCD gauge clusters
- [GT86 / BRZ / FR-S Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/gt86/): GT86 / BRZ / FR-S Digital Cluster for Toyota / Subaru / Scion ZN6 / ZC6 (2013–2020). Non-destructive install. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $899 / Premium $1,049. Fitment: Currently for push-button-start trims with dual-zone climate control. Send photos so we can confirm your car.
- [Civic EK Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/ek/): Civic EK Digital Cluster for Honda EK9 / EK4 / EK3 (1996–2000). Plug-and-play into factory harness. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $899. Fitment: 1996–2000 Honda Civic EK3, EK4, EK9, EJ6, EJ8, EJ9. We confirm by VIN and cluster photos before build.
- [Cayman / Boxster Digital Cluster](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/987/): Cayman / Boxster Digital Cluster for Porsche 987 / 981 (2005–2016). Non-destructive, plug-in harness. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $1,299 / Premium $1,549. Fitment: 987 (2005–2012) and 981 (2013–2016). Fitment varies by options; we confirm before build.

Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $649. Fitment: 2nd-gen GR86 (ZN8) and BRZ (ZD8), 2022–2025. Not for 1st-gen 86/BRZ/FR-S. Pair (left + right).

Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). Standard $1,499 / Premium $2,099. Fitment: 987 Cayman / Boxster and 997 911 three-spoke wheels (2005–2012). Your original airbag and controls transfer over; we recommend professional install.
- [Cayenne Carbon Fiber Mirror Covers](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/c9ymc/): Cayenne Carbon Fiber Mirror Covers for Porsche 9Y0 / 9Y3 (2018–2022). Add-on covers, fit over factory caps. Pair (left + right). Send a photo of your mirrors if unsure.

Mirror cap shells, no wiring. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $299. Fitment: 718 Cayman / Boxster (982) incl. S, GTS, Spyder and GT4, 2016+, left-hand drive (US). Pair (left + right). We confirm your car from a mirror photo before ordering.

Bolts to the rear bumper, pro install advised. Made to order; 3–5 weeks (estimate). $799. Fitment: 718 Cayman / Boxster (982), 2017–2022 with the standard center-exit exhaust. Not for GT4 / Spyder / GT4 RS rear bumpers. We confirm your car from a rear bumper photo before ordering.
- [Front + Rear Shifter Bushing Kit (Polyurethane)](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/sbshb/): Front + Rear Shifter Bushing Kit (Polyurethane) for Subaru / Toyota / Scion WRX / STI / 86 (2002–2021). Bolt-in, replaces the factory rubber shifter bushings. In stock; pay in full at checkout (no deposit); ships direct from our supplier, est. 2–3 weeks. $49. Fitment: Manual-transmission Subaru and Toyota 86 platform shifters: Subaru BRZ, Scion FR-S and Toyota GT86 / 86 (2013–2021, 6-speed manual), WRX STI 6-speed (2004–2021) and WRX (2002–2014). Not for automatic/CVT cars or the 2022+ WRX / GR86 / BRZ. Fitment is per the supplier; tell us your car and gearbox and we confirm before ordering.
- [MX-5 Miata ND Center Armrest Storage Tray](https://tachiclub.oliandcece.com/p/mxtray/): MX-5 Miata ND Center Armrest Storage Tray for Mazda ND (2016–2025). Drop-in tray for the center armrest box, no tools. In stock; pay in full at checkout (no deposit); ships direct from our supplier, est. 2–3 weeks. $109. Fitment: Mazda MX-5 Miata ND (2016+), soft top and RF, left-hand drive. Sits inside the factory center armrest compartment behind the seats. Fitment is per the supplier; tell us your year in the note and if it does not fit we cancel and refund before ordering.

## Policies
- Lead time: 3–5 weeks (estimate); large items such as the 718 rear diffuser 4–6 weeks.
- Deposit & cancellation policy (deposit orders): Custom items are made/sourced to order. After your deposit is paid we email you an order summary (vehicle, VIN, options, lead time) with a Confirm production start link; we do not order parts or start production until you confirm. Cancel before you confirm production start: full refund. Cancel after production/purchasing has started: we refund your deposit minus the actual costs already incurred for your order (materials, machining, freight), with an itemized cost breakdown; the deduction never exceeds your deposit. Once shipped: no returns, refunds or exchanges. Exception: if your item arrives damaged, wrong or missing parts, email support@oliandcece.com with photos within 7 days of delivery; we send a replacement first, or refund you if a replacement is not possible. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method in 5–10 business days.
- Digital clusters: deposit pre-order only for now.
- Fitment is confirmed from VIN/photos before ordering or building.
